value.rationale: The known minimal SoV fairness counterexample asks which valuation regions suffer the failure and whether the optimizer switches continuously. This complete two-dimensional parameter classification gives the exact boundary, fair and unfair regimes, and sharp tie behavior for a natural already-studied minimal market. The fact is not a routine single numerical recalculation.
